name: ResearchRabbit
summary: Literature discovery tool that finds related papers and builds citation maps from a seed set.
description: ResearchRabbit analyses papers a user selects and recommends related research, builds visual citation and author maps, and tracks new publications. The company states it will always have a free offering. The Free plan covers core search; ResearchRabbit+ costs $10 per month on an annual plan or $12.50 monthly and allows larger seed collections. The paid plan allows up to 300 seed articles for large-scale research.
